compute_psnr: compute the PSNR between two image tensors using vqgan or img normalization space
center_crop_image: center crop a PIL image or tensor to a target area scale
resize_image: resize a PIL image or tensor by a given area scale factor
adjust_image_properties: adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, gamma, or sharpness of a normalized image tensor
apply_augmentations: overlay text or apply jpeg compression to a batch of normalized image tensors
